dedupe_keys.name: eclac celade redatam hub with downloadable full census microdata for latin american countries and a directory of online census processing portals for latin america the caribbean africa and asia

description: The REDATAM site of the Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean (ECLAC) and its demographic centre CELADE gives two routes into national census data. A microdata catalogue offers full census databases in Redatam format for download, 19 bases for about a dozen countries totalling 7.4 GB, including Mexico 2020, Guatemala 2018, Chile and Peru 2017, Myanmar 2014, Bolivia 2012, Brazil, Argentina and Ecuador 2010 and El Salvador 2007. An online processing directory lists Redatam Webserver portals run by ECLAC or national offices for 34 countries with data loaded, across Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa and Asia, where users build frequencies, cross tabulations and area lists in the browser. Census dwelling and household files typically carry wall and roof materials, water source, sanitation, lighting or electricity and fuel. Format and access: free downloads without registration and free online processing; the Redatam software is also free. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: some national portals linked from the directory were down or had moved, and variable lists differ between censuses. Simulation uses: small-area dwelling counts by service and building material for exposure and utility planning, and census microdata for synthetic populations. Related records: IPUMS International and the national census records that link to these portals.
